name: coupang-mcp
description: Coupang (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, set_inventory, end_listing. Every tool maps to a d

platform_mcp_coupang_access_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_COUPANG_ACCESS_KEY
platform_mcp_coupang_access_key.description: Coupang Open API Access Key issued in WING (판매자정보 > 추가판매정보 > OPEN API 키 발급) after business verification; calls must come from one of the (up to 10) allow-listed IPs, and keys expire and must be re-issued.

platform_mcp_coupang_secret_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_COUPANG_SECRET_KEY
platform_mcp_coupang_secret_key.description: The matching Secret Key: signs every request (HMAC-SHA256 hex over signed-date + method + path + query, sent as `Authorization: CEA algorithm=HmacSHA256, access-key=..., signed-date=..., signature=...`). Never sent on the wire.

platform_mcp_coupang_vendor_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_COUPANG_VENDOR_ID
platform_mcp_coupang_vendor_id.description: Coupang vendorId (업체코드, e.g. A00012345), shown in WING after login; used by the probe.

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint; the probe lists one registered product ({code, message, nextToken, data[]}) to verify the HMAC keys, IP allow-list and vendorId.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: UPDATE_PRODUCT_PRICE_BY_ITEM: PUT /vendor-items/{vendorItemId}/prices/{price}?forceSalePriceUpdate=true changes the SALE PRICE of one option (listing_id = vendorItemId, 옵션ID) — the price goes live on coupang.com. Only `price` is applied (KRW in Korea, whole number in steps of 10 won); forceSalePriceUpdate=true lifts the default -50%/+100% change guard, so double-check the amount. Use set_inventory for stock; title and description are product-level (modify-product) and are not changed here.

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: UPDATE_PRODUCT_QUANTITY_BY_ITEM: PUT /vendor-items/{vendorItemId}/quantities/{quantity} sets the stock of one option; `listing_id` is the vendorItemId (옵션ID) and is required (Coupang items are not addressed by SKU).

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: STOP_PRODUCT_SALES_BY_ITEM: PUT /vendor-items/{vendorItemId}/sales/stop suspends sales of one option (reversible with /sales/resume); the product itself is not deleted.
